München, Remote (Germany)

Full-time

You support the creation of **consumer-oriented APIs** with your experience. You are part of an international, highly motivated, and cross-functional Scrum team.

As a developer at EvidentIQ, you embody a strong **hands-on mentality** and a **can-do attitude**. You are a reliable partner and mentor for other developers, embrace a test-driven (or even behavior-driven) development approach, and promote an open DevOps work environment.

* Flexible working hours and a modern office
* Attractive compensation package and company pension scheme
* We have short decision-making processes and promote individual responsibility in a modern and flexible working environment

Remote Global

Full-time

Permanent employee

## About Us

Peratera is a UK-based fintech company, founded in 2022 and authorised by the FCA as an Electronic Money Institution.

We are building a modern, all-in-one payment platform that enables businesses to manage global payments and financial operations seamlessly.

Our solution allows companies to open multi-currency accounts, send and receive payments worldwide, and manage cross-border transactions from a single platform.

Our mission is to simplify global finance and remove friction from international business operations.

## Your mission

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will be part of the team building and evolving the user-facing applications behind our financial platform.

* Own frontend development from technical design through implementation, testing, and production delivery
* Build and evolve user-facing applications for payments, accounts, transactions, and other financial workflows
* Develop reusable UI components and features using Angular, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS

* Collaborate with Product, UX/UI, QA, and DevOps to deliver features from initial requirements through production

## What We’re Looking For

* 5+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering
* Strong hands-on experience with modern Angular and React, including Angular 16+ and React 17+

Remote Germany, Berlin, Hamburg, München, Prague

Full-time

## What to expect

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults. 

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

## Your competencies

Mindset

Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need. 

Responsibility

You own what you build, all the way through, not just until it ships and becomes someone else's problem. The parts that go smoothly and the parts that get messy are both yours to see through. You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

Drive

By now the drive is a track record, not a promise. You have years of hard problems behind you and it shows. You understand the whole stack, or you close any gap in it fast, and the hard problems are the ones you go looking for. You are the one who takes the piece nobody else can crack and finds a way through, then leaves the ground solid enough for everyone else to build on. If the hardest part of a project is not the part you reach for, this is not your seat.

What you bring to the table:

* You work across crafts, not in a corner. You are close with developers, designers, and strategists, and you would rather build in the open than behind a wall.

We build complex, end-to-end products for both big-name and niche clients. You are the strongest technical hands on the team, the one the hardest problems land on.

Day to day, that means:

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Operations Automation | Bolt Careers
content:
We're looking for an experienced Applied AI Engineer to join our Growth team and help build operations automation systems for our global mobility platform. If you're excited about applying machine learning to customer support, document verification, and fraud detection challenges across Bolt's 200M+ customers, you'll find plenty of impactful work here.

**About us**

With over 200 million customers across 50+ countries and 850+ cities, Bolt is one of the fastest-growing tech companies in Europe and Africa — powered by 4.5+ million partners on our platform, 4,000+ employees globally. And it's all thanks to our people.

We believe in creating an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or ability.

Our ultimate goal is to make cities for people, not cars — and we need your help on this mission!

**About the role**

Every new customer and order at Bolt can trigger an operational decision: a refund, a document check, an account review, a ruling in a dispute. Our teams already use AI on top of existing processes to make them faster and more accurate. Many of those processes need a redesign from the ground up, and a design that gets better with every decision it makes.

You start with customer support for all users, then move to document verification & fraud detection. After that, any process with high decision volume and a recorded outcome is in scope.

You are hands-on. You ship the product and own the result.

**Main tasks and responsibilities**

* Redesign processes. Mine an area's systems of record, interview the people who run it, and decide which steps become software, agents or human checkpoints.
* Define what great looks like. Turn real cases and human decisions into test sets, and turn every new failure into a regression test.
* Build checks that are hard to game. Calibrate LLM judges against human labels, keep them apart from programmatic checks, and guard cost and payouts.
* Run the improvement loop across policies, prompts, tools and models. Add fine-tuning where a better policy is not enough.
* Own the rollout gates. Decide what ships, run the A/B test, and feed the live result back into the test sets.
* Codify what works so other teams can run it without you.

You are measured on how many decisions you automate while raising their quality.

**About you**

* You come from software engineering, ML or data science, and you have shipped and operated a system that calls LLMs.
* You have built an evaluation suite for an LLM or agent system and used it to decide what ships.
* You have spent dozens of hours in agent traces finding where decisions went wrong, and fixed them.
* You have designed an LLM judge, measured its agreement with human labels, and fixed it when the two disagreed.
* You know how verifiers get gamed, and have caught a case of reward hacking in your work.
